claims.verbatim:
Ship E W Stetson, Hurlbut, Liverpool via Cardiff April 26,
with railroad iron and 44 passengers, to Grinnell, Minturn &
Co. May 9, lat 37, lon 47, Nicholas Driscoll, seaman, of Car-
diff, fell from the foretopsail yard overboard and was lost;
on the outward passage Francis P McBride, seaman, of Sa-
lem, NJ, fell from the maintop to the deck and died, 5 days
afterwards, of his injuries.
